request.query: irrationality exponent at most two, Roth Diophantine lower bounds for every positive epsilon

items.name: Irrational.eventually_forall_le_dist_cast_rat_of_den_le
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Irrational x → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhds 0, ∀ (r : ℚ), r.den ≤ n → ε ≤ dist x ↑r

items.name: Irrational.eventually_forall_le_dist_cast_div_of_denom_le
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Irrational x → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhds 0, ∀ k ≤ n, ∀ (m : ℤ), ε ≤ dist x (↑m / ↑k)

items.name: setOf_liouvilleWith_subset_aux
items.type:
{x | ∃ p > 2, LiouvilleWith p x} ⊆
  ⋃ m,
    (fun x => x + ↑m) ⁻¹'
      ⋃ n, ⋃ (_ : n > 0), {x | ∃ᶠ (b : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ a ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ↑b, |x - ↑a / ↑b| < 1 / ↑b ^ (2 + 1 / ↑n)}

items.name: setOf_liouville_eq_irrational_inter_iInter_iUnion
items.type: {x | Liouville x} = {x | Irrational x} ∩ ⋂ n, ⋃ a, ⋃ b, ⋃ (_ : 1 < b), Metric.ball (↑a / ↑b) (1 / ↑b ^ n)
